review.reason: The English target faithfully renders the Persian source. All key claims are preserved: no hectare-scale yield data is available in the source; the source is a Utah State University Extension home gardening guide; documented yields are 5–10 pounds per ten feet of row with maturity in 60–80 days; water stress (weeks 1–6), soil moisture fluctuations, and crop variety are identified as qualitative yield factors; results are limited to Utah home garden conditions with no commercial, Iranian, or metric conversions derived; and the lack of multi-source confirmation is acknowledged.
